title: Hut 8 Signs 15-Year, 245 MW AI Data Center Lease at River Bend Campus with Total Contract Value of $7.0 Billion
body_markdown:
Press Release


# Hut 8 Signs 15-Year, 245 MW AI Data Center Lease at River Bend Campus with Total Contract Value of $7.0 Billion


Posted Dec 17, 2025


Posted by


Hut 8


- 15-year 245 MW IT lease valued at $7.0 billion over the base term and up to $17.7 billion if all renewal options are exercised


- Google providing a financial backstop covering obligations for the 15-year base lease term


- Hut 8 to implement an institutional-grade execution model designed to de-risk project delivery with blue-chip counterparties—Entergy (NYSE: ETR), J.P. Morgan (NYSE: JPM), Goldman Sachs (NYSE: GS), Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), and Jacobs (NYSE: J)
